subject: reasoning
question:
A + B means ‘A is the father of B’

A – B means ‘A is the mother of B’

A % B means ‘A is the brother of B’

A & B means ‘A is the son of B’

If P – Q % R & S + T, then how is P related to T?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b14085b48bd82c7e02e7108de8499aea5f7cc5c2f297a82bbdd7070983636304.png] 

**Given :**

 
 

 **Code**
 **Meaning**
 
 

 A + B
 A is the father of B
 
 

 A – B
 A is the mother of B
 
 

 A % B
 A is the brother of B
 
 

 A & B
 A is the son of B
 
 

**Given code : **P – Q % R & S + T

**1) **P – Q

‘P – Q’ means 'P is the mother of Q'.

**2) **Q % R

'Q % R' means 'Q is the brother of R'.

**3) **R & S 

R & S means 'R is the son of S'.

**4) **S + T

'S + T' means 'S is the father of T'.

 draw a family tree.,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56422a34902d73998bd662932767701d5c85b062b293eda8cf94d250c3bc5236.png] 

Here , P is mother of T.

Hence, **'Mother'** is the correct answer.
